# Sunscorched Wastes

Endless dunes under a pitiless sun. Heat shimmers; the horizon wavers like a struck gong.

**Read-Aloud**: *The sand stretches to every horizon, bleached white by a sun that offers no mercy. A hot wind scours your lips cracked; each footfall sinks to the ankle. Somewhere ahead a dust-devil spins, briefly revealing — then swallowing — the ribs of something that did not make it across.*

**Atmosphere**: Blistering day, freezing night, no shade, mirages.
**Hazards**: Heatstroke (CON save hourly), water depletion, sandstorms, sinkholes, desert predators.
**Hooks**: Oasis with a hidden spring, buried ruin cresting a dune, caravan of the dead.
**Sounds**: Wind's endless hiss, distant howl of hyenas, creak of shifting sand.
